description: Features as a list of disclosures, the first one open, with an optional picture.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/showcase.ts -->
<!--
  Features as a list of disclosures: icon and title in the summary, the text when open. Axes: expand (first: the
  first one is open, none: all closed), media (none, image: a picture beside the list), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type FeatureAccordionProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  features: Feature[];
  expand?: "first" | "none";
  media?: "none" | "image";
  multiple?: boolean;
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Disclosure from "../primitives/disclosure/disclosure.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Summary from "../primitives/disclosure/summary.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  features,
  expand = "first",
  media = "none",
  multiple = false,
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<FeatureAccordionProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :layout="(((media as string) === 'image') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :media="{ show: ((media as string) === 'image') }"
  >
    <Stack gap="0" align="stretch" data-testid="items">
      <Disclosure v-for="(f, i) in features" :key="f.id"
        variant="item"
        :name="(multiple ? undefined : tpl('{0}-accordion', (id ?? 'accordion')))"
        :open="(((expand as string) === 'first') && (i === 0))"
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <Summary variant="item">
          <Group gap="4" align="center">
            <LucideIcon :name="f.icon" :size="20" />
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
              {{ f.title }}
            </Text>
          </Group>
        </Summary>
        <Text size="sm" class="pb-4 text-muted-foreground">
          {{ f.text }}
        </Text>
      </Disclosure>
    </Stack>
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
